Συντεταγμένες: OSM way/272567726 (ανώνυμο natural=beach) + οικισμός «Μακριά Μύτη» 392 m. Slot κοντά στο #2044 (Παραλία Αλυκή, 1350m). Πρόσβαση/χαρακτηριστικά από οδηγούς — ΔΕΝ έχουν επιβεβαιωθεί επιτόπου.

Paros/Naxos amenity sweep 2026-08-14: Overpass found no amenity, shop, tourism or beach_resort object within 500 m of the pin. The empty list was correct but silent; replaced with the honest wording. Not proof of absence — OSM under-maps rural Greece — so the softer phrase was used.

Water depth from EMODnet bathymetry 2026-08-25: 7.27 m at 100 m offshore on the SW bearing (beach faces 244.6°), profile confidence high. Above the national p75 of 5.9 m, so the water is demonstrably not shallow; recorded as "medium". Bathymetry can prove the steep side only, never the shallow one — no "shallow" is ever written from it. Previously the field was absent and the app inferred depth from shore surface. No other field changed.
